'''Greg Miller Our Most Desparate Hour''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Greg Miller]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls131.htm Our Most Desparate Hour], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027103638/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls131.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Greg Miller]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
